# Parser

The Parser turns a byte stream into JSON tokens. This text sits under the H1.

## Options

`packValues` and `jsonStreaming` control how primitives are reported.

```js
// This # is inside a code fence and must NOT be treated as a heading.
const p = parser({ jsonStreaming: true });
```

## Options
